articles.title: Carrick delivers 5min 27sec monologue and says he will hold brolly to keep everyone dry
articles.summary: Manchester United coach wants ‘humility’ and ‘resilience’ He does not rule out stripping Fernandes of captaincy. Michael Carrick began his Friday media conference with an extraordinary 5min 27sec monologue that cited Manchester United’s values of “humility”, “resilience” and “earning the right to…
body: The head coach, whose job is under threat, later stated “100%” he could turn United’s form around and sought to underline his selfless attitude by saying he would hold an umbrella for “everyone else to stay dry” while he got wet.

The downpour on Carrick intensified on Wednesday when Bruno Fernandes questioned his tactics after a 4-1 Champions League loss at Como and the 45-year-old did not rule out dropping the midfielder or stripping him of the captaincy when Bournemouth visit on Sunday. “I’ll always do what’s best for the football club,” he said. “The most important thing for me is the team, first and foremost – the squad, the dynamics in the squad.”

Carrick decided to make his speech, delivered without being asked a question, after events in Como and Lisandro Martínez’s criticism of Jason Wilcox a week earlier for the director of football’s recruitment.

articles.title: AFC Wimbledon's Skiverton diagnosed with cancer
articles.summary: AFC Wimbledon assistant manager Terry Skiverton is scheduled to begin treatment in the coming weeks after being diagnosed with throat cancer.
body: AFC Wimbledon assistant manager Terry Skiverton has been diagnosed with throat cancer and is scheduled to begin treatment in the coming weeks.
The League One club said Skiverton had faced further health challenges since announcing in July that he would take time away from his duties to recover from ankle surgery.

A club statement said:, external "Terry has been receiving valuable support from the League Managers Association (LMA) in recent months, and the club will continue to stand alongside him and his family throughout his treatment and recovery.
"Everyone at AFC Wimbledon sends Terry their heartfelt best wishes as he prepares for the next stage of his treatment."

articles.title: Arteta concerned over Saka’s durability as forward faces possible six-week absence
articles.summary: Arteta: ‘We need to understand how to manage his load’ Max Dowman could play against Everton on Saturday. Mikel Arteta has expressed concern over Bukayo Saka’s robustness after a series of injuries to the forward in the past year and as he awaits further news on how long he will be out for with a…
body: Saka is set for an MRI scan after limping off in the 2-2 draw with Bayern Munich in the Champions League, with Arteta revealing the 25-year-old had “quite a lot of fluid in the area so it was difficult to understand the extent of the injury”. Saka will definitely miss Saturday’s game against Evertonand, it is understood, Arsenal fear it could be a grade-two tear that could potentially keep him out for up to six weeks.

Saka missed a large portion of last season due to hamstring, hip and achilles tendon injuries having also been sidelined by another hamstring issue in 2024-25. In total, he has had 11 different injuries since September 2023 and Arteta insisted that he has been trying to ease his workload as a result. “It’s certainly been different in the last year or so,” the Spaniard said when asked if Saka remains robust enough to start every match. “The demands that we are putting on every player are immense. The amount of games, the intensity of those matches, the international competitions, the times as well between games are getting narrower.

articles.title: Mamdani loves Arsenal. He should challenge them to cut ties with the UAE over Sudan | Sasha Lezhnev and John Prendergast
articles.summary: The New York mayor’s passion for the Gunners and human rights presents an opportunity to push back on the club’s lucrative UAE sponsorship. Like him or not, there is no doubt that New York mayor Zohran Mamdani’s passion for certain issues is electric, and that passion played a large part in him…
body: On one hand, Mamdani is now arguably the US’s most high-profile supporter of English Premier League champions Arsenal. A superfan since he was a child, he has put the Gunners into the American spotlight more than anyone since becoming mayor. The Empire State Building gleamed in Arsenal’s red and white when they won the Premier League title. He wrote an essay about what Arsenal’s championship means to him, talks about Arsenal at press conferences and interviews and inaugurated Thierry Henry Way near Times Square in honor of the Arsenal legend.

But another of Mamdani’s passions – standing up against genocide and for human rights – is now presenting a problem for the mayor’s Arsenal fandom. One prominent part of Arsenal’s current image is deeply disturbing, and it presents a major opportunity for Mamdani.

articles.title: Dvalishvili gains 19lb in five hours before title fight
articles.summary: Merab Dvalishvili says he has gained 19lb (1st 5lb) in just five hours after weighing in for his bantamweight title fight against Petr Yan at UFC 333 on Saturday.
body: The Georgian weighed 135lb (9st 9lb), which was the same as Russian champion Yan, before the pair's co-main event fight in Abu Dhabi.
Dvalishvili later uploaded a video to Instagram showing the 35-year-old stepping on scales and weighing 154lb (11st 0lb).
"I've been drinking water and in only five hours I gain back 19 pounds, that's what we do, let's go," he said.
"Now I'm back drinking and recovering. Now I'm going to start eating. Eat food first, then tomorrow you guys already know who I'm going to eat."

The race began behind the safety car due to heavy rain that had fallen on the Italian circuit earlier in the afternoon; the safety car pulled in after four laps, allowing racing to commence.

While NIFL have said that their "final position remains subject to UEFA's rankings and access arrangements", as it stands that would mean the Irish Premiership will have only three European spots in the 2028-29 season.
Currently the Irish Premiership's top two and Irish Cup winners automatically qualify for the next season's Uefa competitions, while the league's final spot is decided by an end-of-season play-off.

articles.title: Bruno Fernandes position in doubt? Michael Carrick refuses to guarantee Man Utd star's place after tactical outburst
articles.summary: Michael Carrick has refused to guarantee Bruno Fernandes will keep the Manchester United captaincy after the midfielder publicly questioned his tactical decisions. The head coach dodged questions regarding the Portuguese star's future in the starting line-up ahead of their crucial clash against…
body: Carrick has refused to guarantee that Fernandes will retain his starting spot or the United captaincy. The head coach faced difficult questions ahead of Bournemouth's upcoming visit to Old Trafford on Sunday. The uncertainty follows a heavy 4-1 defeat to Como, which sparked public frustration from the Portuguese midfielder.

Fernandes openly questioned the tactical setup during a post-match television interview. He revealed that Carrick and his coaching staff decided against pressing the Italian side man-for-man. Fernandes suggested this specific tactical choice directly contributed to the heavy loss.

Speaking at his pre-match press conference on Friday, Carrick was directly asked if he would consider dropping Fernandes or stripping him of the armband. The United boss carefully dodged the question, opting instead to emphasise his commitment to the overall squad.

"The most important thing for me is the team, first and foremost," Carrick explained, as quoted by ESPN. "It's the squad, it's the dynamics in the squad. And again, it's about the football club. And I'll always do what's best for the football club.
points: Michael Carrick has refused to guarantee Bruno Fernandes will keep the Manchester United captaincy after the midfielder publicly questioned his tactical decisions.

articles.title: NFL predictions: Get ready for a rock fight in Titans-Browns matchup
articles.summary: This matchup between the Cleveland Browns and Tennessee Titans looks to be the most boring game of the week. The total in this game currently sits at 37.5 over at FanDuel Sportsbook. That is the lowest total of the week, and the under might be the smart bet.
body: The key for the Titans in this game will be taking care of the ball. Last week, the Titans forced three turnovers against the Indianapolis Colts. That, and a couple of key special teams plays, were the difference in the game. This game will likely play out in a similar way.

Speaking of special teams plays, it was really good to see Chimere Dike break off a 58-yard punt return against the Colts. Dike was the biggest weapon the Titans had last season, but he had struggled this season before last week. Hopefully, that was the start of his return to the All-Pro returner he was last season.

This game does feature two good rookie wide receivers. Denzel Boston leads all rookie receivers with 345 yards and is averaging over 20 yards per catch. Carnell Tate is right behind him with 344 yards. If one of those guys can break a big play, it could be the difference in this game.

Don’t expect a thrilling game when you sit down to watch this one on Sunday, but if the Titans can play a game similar to the one they did last week, they might have a chance at back-to-back wins for the first time since 2022.

Goncalves is under contract until 2030, but his current release clause is set at €60m, a figure that has clearly sharpened interest across the market.

The report outlines a player of growing appeal, someone capable of operating on either wing or through central attacking midfield. That versatility matters. Clubs recruiting at the top end increasingly want forwards who can fill multiple roles, especially in compressed schedules and tactical systems that demand movement between lines.

articles.summary: Ian Poulter has become the latest high-profile golfer to confirm that he will leave LIV Golf, as uncertainty grows on which players will feature in any proposed new iteration of the circuit.
body: LIV Golf saw Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund (PIF) ended their funding earlier this season but have since secured investment from BC Partners Credit, as they look to relaunch and continue in 2027.

The league filed for bankruptcy protection in September with a Chapter 11 petition, which they said was to "preserve the company's business" as it attempts to restructure, with players left to decide whether they wish to re-sign with LIV Golf.

Poulter has been part of LIV Golf since their inaugural 2022 event in London and has been a co-captain of Majesticks GC over the last four seasons, but the Englishman has elected against being part of the proposed new LIV schedule to "pursue other interests".
In a statement issued on social media, Poulter said: "I wanted everyone to hear it direct from me that I have decided to not move forward with being part of LIV 2.0.
